documents.name: Planning Commission Minutes - 2024-07-01
documents.synopsis: Official minutes of the July 1, 2024 Sykesville Planning Commission meeting. May 6 minutes approved. Informational updates: Schoolhouse Rd subdivision awaiting MDE approval for W&S amendment; Joy Property at 7306 Springfield Ave has conditional use approval, site plan in progress; Parkside stormwater management deficiency and Enclave hold; historic train station preliminary approval from Maryland Historic Trust. Springfield Ave roadwork rescheduled for fall 2024.
